method: Independent model linguistic review of all 500 candidates, all supplied English lexical alternatives and retained Spanish evidence. Each approval selects one exact English sense index/raw-record hash and a source-grounded English predicate; derivatives are model-reviewed selected renderings, not verbatim dictionary quotations or native-human certification. Retain selected context and relevant rare/regional/register warnings. Literal nonhuman-only agent readings use it-only; human operators acting on entities, human bodily processes, conventional crew/rider uses and source-attested human figuratives are distinguished. No mandatory pronominal construction, unfilled causative middle-object frame, invented personal subject, qualified English inflection override or guessed Spanish paradigm is authorized. Ordinary word-level trailing ellipses are selected meanings, not complete example sentences. Aspect modes authorize only the stated contextual reading, subject to explicit source grammar/person and pinned AGID guards. Potential child counts are not actual translation coverage.
